headline: Apple Announces iPhone 18 Pro Will Only Turn On If The User Performs A Synchronized Sunrise Yoga Sequence
body:
The Cupertino-based tech giant confirmed today that its upcoming iPhone 18 Pro will feature a mandatory 'Holistic Wake' sensor, requiring owners to complete a flawless Surya Namaskar within 45 seconds to unlock the screen each morning. Apple’s Vice President of Wellness Hardware, speaking from the company’s new forest-themed lab, explained that the decision was driven by data suggesting users were ‘too stagnant’ during their morning doom-scrolling sessions.

‘We realized that the primary barrier to peak productivity isn’t the processor speed, but the user’s lack of spinal flexibility,’ the spokesperson said, while demonstrating a perfect downward dog on a conference table. ‘The phone uses advanced lidar to track your limb extension; if your heels don’t touch the floor by the third sun salutation, the device politely initiates a 24-hour hydration reminder and locks itself into a meditative silent mode.’

Retail stores have already begun installing padded rubber flooring in anticipation of the September launch, with regional managers confirming that staff will be trained to act as certified yoga instructors to help customers calibrate their devices. The company noted that while the feature cannot be disabled, a ‘Pro Max’ subscription tier will eventually allow users to substitute the yoga routine with a brisk 5K run around the store perimeter.
caption: Apple’s new iPhone 18 Pro will require users to perform yoga to unlock their screens. Finally, a phone that cares about your posture more than your battery life. #AppleEvent #iPhone18 #YogaTech #TechNews (satire)
